req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should support partial updates via the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. This means that if a field is omitted in the request payload, it should remain unchanged in the database. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct partial update behavior, a negative test to handle invalid task IDs, and a boundary test to ensure that the system correctly handles updates with minimal payloads.

tests.name: test_partial_update_positive
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a partial payload to update only the title.
expected: The task's title is updated, and other fields remain unchanged.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Title", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Partial update
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"title": "Updated Title"})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()

# Expected: Verify partial update
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Title"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Initial Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False

tests.name: test_partial_update_invalid_task_id
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/9999 with a partial payload.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_response = client.put("/tasks/9999", json={"title": "Non-existent Task"})

# Expected: Verify 404 response
assert update_response.status_code == 404
assert update_response.json()['detail'] == "Task with id 9999 not found"

tests.name: test_partial_update_boundary_case
preconditions: A task with id 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with an empty payload.
expected: No fields are changed in the task.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to update
create_response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Title", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert create_response.status_code == 201
created_task = create_response.json()
task_id = created_task['id']

# Action: Attempt to update with an empty payload
update_response = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={})
assert update_response.status_code == 200
updated_task = update_response.json()

# Expected: Verify no changes
assert updated_task['title'] == "Boundary Title"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Boundary Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is False
